criteria.combination: ALL mandatory checks must pass; no outcome filtering, retries with changed bounds, or denominator floors
criteria.finite_rule: All loss/norm scalars, reference gradients, valid device moments, derived gradients and defined numeric metrics must be finite; undefined zero-vector per-parameter cosines are diagnostic nulls, and the exact-zero branch still gates
criteria.identities_and_step: Exact ordered batch IDs, projection hash, source, B0 identity, global scaling, all 32 rank identities, and Adam/checkpoint step 1
criteria.metric_accumulation: Convert both gradients to FP64 before differences, products and squared sums; combine chunk sums with math.fsum
criteria.parameter_names_and_shapes: Exact match to the bound released-parameter inventory; verify runtime parameter-to-optimizer-ID mapping before extraction
criteria.reference_norm_denominator: Exact full-vector or full-parameter FP64 L2 norm; no epsilon or fitted absolute floor
criteria.shard_coverage: Compare each of the 1,720,574,976 valid coordinates exactly once; exclude only verified ZeRO shape padding and the tied alias
criteria.tied_parameter_rule: The embedding and head must share Parameter identity and are counted once
criteria.zero_reference_parameter_rule: If every FP64 reference entry is zero, every estimated device entry must equal zero; signed zero counts as zero

estimation: FP32 exp_avg(step 1).double() / (0.1 * actual FP32 device clip coefficient)

memory_monitor_summary.sampling_limitations: neuron-monitor snapshots; process runtime aggregate is not a physical per-bank HBM maximum; transient events between samples may be missed.

incoming_moments: Fresh ordinary driver optimizer, no --resume, installed zero initialization; step 1 checked for every shard/parameter
limitations: Designed after diagnosis of v1 failure; this is a new prospective test identity, not a retroactive v1 pass.
Held seed means new deterministic order, not disjoint data or an unseen corpus; all overlap is listed.
FP64 arithmetic uses frozen native-CPU FP32 RoPE constants and local precision-preserving RMSNorm/softmax formulas; it is not a unique device-RoPE truth.
Device raw gradients are estimated through FP32 first-moment and clipping arithmetic; rounding remains in the estimate.
Passing concerns one common-B0 first derivative and its scaling; it does not assert coordinatewise CPU trajectory identity or useful-thought efficacy.
The scientific recipe, datasets, objective, precision, optimizer, and previously fixed same-hardware resume requirements remain unchanged.
parameter_mapping: Pinned driver model.parameters() order, model state_dict order excluding tied lm_head alias, and independent native named_parameters() order agree; every optimizer ID/shape checked
scope: One ordinary common-B0 C32 first update, compared with an independently computed FP64 derivative on prospectively frozen seed-5678 TRAIN records.
